name: onboarding_completed
description: A person finished an onboarding flow. The activation metric, and the event most likely to be instrumented wrongly.
trigger: Every required step of the flow has been completed and the product considers the person onboarded. Once per person per flow.
nonTriggers: Do not fire because a success or welcome page rendered. A page render is not a completed flow, and this substitution turns activation into a page-view metric.
Do not fire when the person reaches the last step without finishing it.
Do not fire a second time for a person who repeats the flow; completion is once per person per flow.

properties.name: flow_id
properties.description: Stable identifier of the onboarding flow, e.g. initial_setup. A flow, not a flow run.

properties.name: duration_ms
properties.description: Milliseconds from onboarding_started to completion for this person and flow.
